review_policy: Review on every product release, before regulated functionality is released, at least every 180 days, and whenever an applicable act is published, amended, revoked, or replaced.
disclaimer: Engineering compliance baseline. It does not replace clinical or legal/regulatory review, and regulated release remains blocked until both accountable roles accept the documented scope.

acts.title: CFP Resolution 10/2005 — Professional Code of Ethics for Psychologists
acts.history: Approves the current professional code of ethics; no replacement identified in the official CFP source review dated 2026-09-01.

acts.title: CFP Resolution 01/2009 — Mandatory records for psychological services
acts.history: Amended by CFP Resolution 05/2010. CFP's current guidance still identifies Resolution 01/2009, as amended, as the governing record rule.

acts.title: CFP Resolution 06/2019 — Written psychological documents
acts.history: Replaced CFP Resolution 04/2019 and revoked CFP Resolutions 15/1996 and 07/2003.

acts.title: CFP Resolution 16/2019 — Registration of legal entities providing Psychology services
acts.history: Published in the DOU on 2019-09-05 with entry into force after 60 days. Remains effective as amended by CFP Resolution 08/2023, which changed its article 6 sole-owner annual-fee exemption.

acts.title: CFP Resolution 08/2023 — Annual-fee policy and amendment to Resolution 16/2019
acts.history: Published in the DOU on 2023-05-09 and effective on publication. Article 4 amended CFP Resolution 16/2019 regarding the annual-fee exemption for a Psychology-services legal entity constituted by a sole owner who is a psychologist.

acts.title: CFP Resolution 09/2024 — Psychology practice mediated by TDICs
acts.history: Revoked CFP Resolution 11/2018 and CFP Resolution 04/2020. Effective source reviewed on 2026-09-01.

acts.title: CRP-02/PE legal-entity registration and certificate guidance
acts.issuer: Conselho Regional de Psicologia da 2ª Região — Pernambuco
acts.history: Operational CRP-02 guidance current when reviewed on 2026-09-01; it references registration, technical responsibility, professional regularity, inspection, and certificate renewal. Recheck against formal acts before legal acceptance.

obligations.history: Initial product mapping; legal/regulatory validation pending.
obligations.scope: Professional confidentiality, interprofessional sharing, minors, recording methods, and custody on service interruption.
obligations.product_applicability: Authorization, consent, messaging, audit, minors, exports, incident response, and clinical records.
obligations.derived_requirement: Deny access by default; disclose only necessary authorized data; record purpose and actor; inform the service user about recording; protect records during staff or service transitions.
obligations.noncompliance_risk: Unauthorized disclosure of sensitive data and professional ethical violation.

obligations.provision: Articles 1 through 6, as amended by CFP Resolution 05/2010
obligations.history: Resolution 01/2009 is treated as amended by Resolution 05/2010; exact consolidated text requires acceptance review.
obligations.scope: Minimum psychological record content, organization, confidentiality, user access, custody, restricted material, and minimum retention.
obligations.product_applicability: Psychological records, restricted assessment material, data-subject access, retention, legal hold, export, and backup restoration.
obligations.derived_requirement: Maintain versioned, attributable and confidential records; segregate restricted assessment material; support lawful access; retain for the approved period and prevent destructive changes after signature.
obligations.noncompliance_risk: Incomplete or improperly exposed records, premature deletion, and inability to evidence professional work.

obligations.history: Resolution 06/2019 replaced Resolution 04/2019 and revoked Resolutions 15/1996 and 07/2003.
obligations.scope: Preparation, purpose, technical basis, authorship, professional identification, delivery, interview, custody, and validity of written psychological documents.
obligations.product_applicability: Document templates, generation, signature, delivery, export, corrections, and retention.
obligations.derived_requirement: Only an eligible professional may author and sign an applicable document; preserve the exact version and technical basis; distinguish document classes; audit delivery and correction by addendum.
obligations.noncompliance_risk: Invalid, misleading, unsigned, or improperly delivered psychological documents.

obligations.provision: Legal-entity registration, registration categories, technical responsibility, and current certificate requirements
obligations.history: National baseline mapped from the official acts catalog and CRP-02 current guidance; article-level legal review pending.
obligations.scope: Legal entities whose main or secondary activity includes Psychology services.
obligations.product_applicability: Clinic activation, professional membership, technical supervisor, regulated feature flags, and compliance evidence.
obligations.derived_requirement: Fail closed for regulated Psychology services when required clinic registration, technical supervisor, certificate, or professional regularity evidence is absent, expired, revoked, or unverified.
obligations.noncompliance_risk: Unregistered or irregular legal entity offering regulated Psychology services.

obligations.provision: Articles governing TDIC-mediated services, professional responsibility, service agreement, confidentiality, suitability, records, territorial rules, and emergency/protection contexts
obligations.scope: Psychology services mediated by digital information and communication technologies in Brazil.
obligations.product_applicability: Onboarding, service agreement, consent, telehealth, messaging, crisis copy, professional eligibility, records, integrations, and continuity.
obligations.derived_requirement: Present and preserve a versioned service agreement; identify the responsible eligible professional and technologies; protect confidentiality; assess suitability and jurisdiction; provide non-emergency boundaries and approved local referral paths.
obligations.noncompliance_risk: Remote service without adequate agreement, professional accountability, confidentiality, or emergency planning.

obligations.history: Resolution 08/2023 amended the sole-owner annual-fee exemption in Resolution 16/2019 and entered into force on publication.
obligations.scope: Legal entities providing Psychology services that are constituted by a sole owner who is a psychologist.
obligations.product_applicability: Clinic legal-entity classification, registration evidence, compliance review, and any display of CFP/CRP fee status.
obligations.derived_requirement: Record legal-entity category and current registration evidence without inferring fee liability; any exemption shown or used operationally must be confirmed against Resolution 08/2023 and the competent CRP decision.
obligations.noncompliance_risk: Incorrect fee or registration treatment for a sole-owner Psychology-services legal entity.

obligations.provision: Current CRP-02 Pessoa Jurídica registration and certificate-renewal guidance
obligations.history: Website operational guidance captured on 2026-09-01; formal CRP-02 and CFP acts prevail and must be confirmed at acceptance.
obligations.scope: Legal entities providing Psychology services in Pernambuco and their technical supervisors and psychologists.
obligations.product_applicability: Pernambuco clinic onboarding, document collection, technical supervisor, professional regularity, certificate validity, renewal, inspection evidence, and regulated module activation.
obligations.derived_requirement: Collect only justified registration evidence; track technical supervisor and professional regularity; track certificate validity and renewal; block regulated activation when required evidence is not current.
obligations.noncompliance_risk: Clinic operation in Pernambuco without current registration, technical responsibility, or certificate evidence.
